findings.note: Nov 15, 2026 RotoWire note: Dubois has 12 points in 13 games and stays a top-six center, but his recent production is mostly goals, with 4 G and only 1 A during his four-game goal streak; Washington lost 7-4 to the Devils.

Early-season notes show him centering the Wilson/Tuch line, with two multi-point games in his first three, including two assists in the opener; older news items also show a 'return Saturday' note about 25 days ago, so he recently missed time.

Injury history: abdominal surgery in 2025-26 and a fractured hand in April 2026 limited him to 29 games, though he had 46 assists in 2024-25. One search returned no game-day injury, line or analyst-pick reporting for this game.
